verses.1: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, + 28:1 Literally Now after the Sabbaths, it being dawn toward the first of the Sabbaths, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
verses.2: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
verses.3: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
verses.4: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
verses.5: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
verses.6: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay. + 28:6 BYZ and TR where the Lord lay
verses.7: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
verses.8: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
verses.9: Suddenly + 28:9 BYZ and TR They were going to tell His disciples, and suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
verses.10:
“Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.” 
 The Report of the Guards
verses.11: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
verses.12: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
verses.13: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
verses.14: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
verses.15:
So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
 The Great Commission
 ( Mark 16:14–18|MRK 16:14-18 )
verses.16: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
verses.17: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
verses.18: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
verses.19: Therefore go and make disciples + 28:19 Literally Having gone, therefore, make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
verses.20: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
